王野也不说话，只是看向院子。黄飞龙看见王野的眼神，知道他不会相信，但是这里有他大哥的一份儿，也不怕王野会怎样。就这样沉默了几秒钟，王野率先开口：“强子现在是我师弟的事儿，龙哥知道吧？”

黄飞龙点点头：“知道，强子说了，还说王野兄弟非常厉害。”

王野看了看曹强，转过头来面无表情的问道：“这小子脑子不太好，你们不会是把他当成打手吧？”

一听这话，再看着王野的神态，这种样子他只在他爹那辈儿人身上见过，顿时后背都出汗了：“怎么会呢，我家老头子和曹叔是生死弟兄，我要是敢把强子当打手，我家老头子都得把我的腿打断。”

这种事儿是根本避免不了的，在一个团体里，有这样一个，脑子不太好，武力值又高的人。时间久了必然会成为有些人手里的刀，在岁数不大的时候可能还有兄弟义气，过上几年，等级更分明了，曹强一定逃脱不了当打手的命运。

王野对他们这个圈子不熟，但是在后世，他所在的底层中，从来没有听说过有什么恶性事件。这只有两种可能，一个是信息封锁的严密，另一个是这个圈子有他的规则。

前一个可能性不大，在信息爆炸的时代，屁大点儿事儿都能闹得沸沸扬扬，更别说这样爆炸的新闻了。唯一的解释就是他们有自己的规则，只是不知道现在是不是也有这样的规则。

如果没有，以强子的脑子，迟早得栽个大跟头。王野可不想给这个憨憨的师弟送盒饭，而这个黄飞龙有脑子，有手段，在那次的聚会上，隐隐觉得他是这个团体的三号人物。

现在他们都是一起长大的发小，三年五年之内，都会相亲相爱，可是当他尝到权力的滋味后，就不知道会怎样了。如果是出差之前的王野，碰上这种问题，第一想法就是让曹强渐渐脱离这个团体。

但是现在可不一样了，王野想面对这一切，他不想带着外挂还要憋屈过完一生。他想要的是自由自在，过自己的小日子。这个目标看似不大，但是自由的程度才是重点。如果只是想着老婆孩子热炕头，他现在完全可以做到了。

但是想要让一些麻烦不敢找自己那就难了，这就是为什么王野只是冷脸询问，并没有下定义的原因。他要给黄飞龙一个随时都可以收拾他的印象，当然这个印象只针对黄飞龙个人，要是对上黄家，王野不靠别人他就是个渣渣。

王野微微一笑：“龙哥，我就是这么一问，没别的意思，你跟强子是发小儿，我相信你肯定不会让他吃亏的，对吧？”

黄飞龙：“肯定，肯定。”

王野站起身来：“龙哥，我没别的事儿了，你是个大忙人，耽误你这么长时间挺过意不去了，改天我做东咱在好好联络一下感情。”

黄飞龙巴不得赶紧送走这个瘟神，这货现在是软硬不吃呀。打又打不过，用手段人家靠山也不小呀。王野出了院子，开始在鸽子市上闲逛了一圈，这里还是和以前一样。整个鸽子市没什么特殊的东西。

王野转了一圈，发现那帮遗老遗少更多了，一个个的扎着脑袋。王野走到一个摊位前，蹲了下来，他并不知道这个摊位上的是真是假，但是这些东西他很需要，这里摆满了笔墨纸砚。

王野看了一会儿问道：“大爷，你这些东西怎么卖的？”

老头头都没抬：“我这些都是古董，不是一般的文房四宝，你买的起吗？”

王野听这老头傲娇的口气反问道：“大爷，现在的古董什么价，你老也有数吧？说句不中听的话，就你这些东西，在这一个鸽子市上都没几个要的，饭都吃不饱，谁还有心情陶冶情操呀？”

老人听了王野的话叹了口气：“唉，小兄弟说的没毛病，但这些也是我的心头好呀，价格低了我可不卖。”

王野：“价高价低的你总得说个价呀。”

Wang Ye didn't say anything, just looked towards the yard.Huang Feilong saw the look in Wang Ye's eyes and knew that he wouldn't believe it, but since he was his elder brother here, he was not afraid of what Wang Ye would do.There was silence for a few seconds before Wang Ye spoke first: "Qiangzi is my junior brother's business now, does Brother Long know?"

Huang Feilong nodded: "I know, Qiangzi said it, and he also said that Brother Wang Ye is very powerful."

Wang Ye looked at Cao Qiang, turned around and asked expressionlessly: "This kid has a bad mind. Don't you think of him as a thug?"

As soon as he heard this and looked at Wang Ye's expression, which he had only seen in people of his father's generation, he suddenly started sweating on his back: "How could it be possible? My old man and Uncle Cao are brothers in life and death. If I dare to use Qiangzi as a thug, my old man will have to break my legs."

This kind of thing is simply unavoidable. In a group, there is such a person who is not very smart and has high force value.As time goes by, it will inevitably become a knife in the hands of some people. When he was young, he might still have brotherly loyalty. After a few years, the hierarchy will become clearer, and Cao Qiang will definitely not be able to escape the fate of being a thug.

Wang Ye was not familiar with their circle, but in later generations, he had never heard of any vicious incidents among his lower class.There are only two possibilities, one is that the information is strictly blocked, and the other is that this circle has its own rules.

The former one is unlikely. In the era of information explosion, any big thing can make a big fuss, let alone such explosive news.The only explanation is that they have their own rules, but I don't know if they have such rules now.

If not, with Qiangzi's mind, he would be in trouble sooner or later.Wang Ye didn't want to give a lunch box to this silly junior brother, but Huang Feilong had brains and means. At that party, he vaguely felt that he was the third person in the group.

Now they both grew up together, and within three to five years, they would fall in love with each other, but when he tasted the taste of power, he didn't know what would happen.If it were Wang Ye before his business trip and encountered this kind of problem, his first thought would be to let Cao Qiang gradually leave the group.

But things are different now. Wang Ye wants to face all this. He doesn't want to live a life of humiliation with a cheat.What he wants is to be free and live his own life.This goal may seem small, but the degree of freedom is the key.If he just thinks about his wife and children, he can do it now.

But it is difficult to prevent some troubles from coming to you. This is why Wang Ye just asked with a cold face and did not define it.He wanted to give Huang Feilong the impression that he could deal with him at any time. Of course, this impression was only for Huang Feilong personally. If he faced the Huang family, Wang Ye would be a scumbag if he didn't rely on others.

Wang Ye smiled slightly: "Brother Long, that's what I'm asking. I don't mean anything else. You and Qiangzi are just kids. I believe you won't let him suffer, right?"

Huang Feilong: "Absolutely, definitely."

Wang Ye stood up: "Brother Long, I don't have anything else to do. You are a busy man. I feel sorry for delaying you for so long. I will be the host another day and we will keep in touch with each other."

Huang Feilong was eager to send this plague god away as soon as possible. This guy was too soft to eat now.He can't beat him again and again, but he has a lot of backers for his tricks.Wang Ye left the yard and began to wander around the pigeon market. The place was still the same as before.There is nothing special about the entire Pigeon City.

Wang Ye turned around and found that there were more old people and young people in the group, and they all had their heads stabbed.Wang Ye walked to a stall and squatted down. He didn't know whether the items on this stall were real or fake, but he needed these things very much. The place was filled with pens, ink, paper and inkstones.

Wang Ye looked at it for a while and asked: "Uncle, how do you sell these things?"

The old man didn't even raise his head: "These are antiques, not ordinary Four Treasures of the Study. Can you afford them?"

Wang Ye heard the old man's arrogant tone and asked back: "Uncle, you know the price of antiques nowadays, right? To put it bluntly, few of you can buy these things in this pigeon market. You can't even eat enough. Who is in the mood to cultivate their sentiments?"

The old man sighed after listening to Wang Ye's words: "Oh, what the little brother said is right, but these are also my favorites. I won't sell them if the price is low."

Wang Ye: "If the price is high or the price is low, you have to decide the price."
